A good read starts here

Something catch your eye? On Home, browse the shelves and tap a book to open it. Scroll at your own pace and enjoy the first few pages. 

For your first visit, stay connected while the chapters load. Entries marked as library cards have book details but no readable text.

You can start without an account.
Find your way around
Ready for another chapter? Tap the reading area to show the menus, choose Contents, and tap an available chapter to jump in. Use Back to return to Home when you feel like browsing again.
Make the page feel right

Bigger letters? A little more breathing room? Show the reader menus and tap Aa. Try Font size, Line height, and Text alignment until reading feels comfortable.\n\nChoose Paper, Sepia, or Night to set the mood. The theme carries through the rest of the app too. For a different font, visit Settings > Reading & Display. Bookshelf remembers your choices.
Search
Find your next good read—or that passage you want to revisit.
Follow your curiosity

Have an author, title, or favourite subject in mind? On Home, tap Search. Leave Search book contents off to look through book details, enter your search, and tap Search. Tap a book that catches your eye to open it.
Find the words inside

Remember a phrase, or want to see what books say about a topic? Turn on Search book contents to search chapter text instead of book details. Enter 4 to 160 characters and tap Search. Searching chapters can take a little longer.
Jump into a match

Read the chapter title and excerpt for a taste of each result. Found something interesting? Tap Open matching chapter when it is available to go straight to that chapter.\n\nTo look for titles, authors, or subjects again, turn Search book contents off.
Save a book and return to it
Keep a good find close and pick up where you left off.
Make room on your shelf

Found a keeper? With the book open, show the reader menus and tap Save. You can also press and hold a book card and choose Add to My Books. Your saved books are waiting in My Books.\n\nSaving works without an account. When connected to an account, saving can ask your signer to share your bookshelf publicly.
Leave a little for later

Read a little or a lot, then use Back when it is time for a break. Bookshelf remembers your reading position on this device.\n\nOn Home, Continue reading opens your most recently opened saved book. You can also reopen a book from My Books. You do not need to turn on tracking to resume reading.
Read offline
Bring a good book along, even when the connection stays behind.
Pack a book for the journey

Train ride, quiet getaway, or just a patchy connection? Save your book, then open it online and let the chapters load. Bookshelf keeps the loaded content of saved books for offline reading. Saving alone does not download the text.
Try a little offline reading

Before you head out, check Contents for unavailable chapters and try reopening the book without an internet connection. If the pages you want are there, you are ready to settle in. Only stored chapters will be readable offline.
Refill your offline shelf

Clearing the Offline reading cache in Settings > Storage & Offline removes stored book content. Your saved-book list and reading position remain.\n\nOpen your saved books online again before relying on them offline.
Keep the lines you love
Save a passage that makes you smile, think, or want to read it twice.
Catch a favourite line

Some sentences deserve a second visit. Long-press a passage and drag to select the words you want, then tap Create highlight. It is saved privately on this device; no account needed.\n\nIf the same words appear more than once in the chapter, include a little more surrounding text so Bookshelf can identify the passage.
Revisit your favourites

Tap the reading area to show the menus, then choose Highlights. Browse your saved passages and tap Open passage to return to their chapter.\n\nChanged your mind about a private highlight? Use Delete while it is still private and has not been queued for publication.
Pass a good line along

Want to share what caught your eye? With an account connected, choose Publish on a private highlight. Add an optional comment, tap Publish highlight, and review the request in your signer. Publishing shares the passage and comment publicly on Nostr.\n\nYou can also keep it just for yourself. Queued or published highlights cannot be deleted here.
Share your take on a book
Give a book some stars and help another reader find their next good read.
Your turn to weigh in
Loved it, puzzled by it, still thinking about it? Press and hold the book card and choose Rate and review. Connect your account first if you want to publish your thoughts.
A few stars and your own words

Choose one to five stars. Your opinion is optional: a sentence about what stayed with you can be enough. Tap Publish review and review the request in your signer. Your rating and any written review are public on Nostr.\n\nIf delivery has to wait for a connection, Bookshelf keeps the signed review for retry.
Give it another thought
A reread can change your mind. Open Rate and review again with the same account to load your existing review. Adjust the stars or your words, then tap Publish changes and review the signer request.
Put your next read in the spotlight

Want this book waiting for you on Home? With it open, show the reader menus. Check whether new tracking is On this device or Public on Nostr, then tap Track progress beside the position information.\n\nThe book appears in Reading now on Home. If section order is unavailable, tracking is not ready yet.
Look back without losing your place

Feel like rereading a favourite bit? Your current position can move backward while tracking remembers the furthest section you have reached. Automatic resume keeps the spot where you stopped on this device.\n\nFor sharing choices, open Settings > Reading progress & privacy. Public updates may show pending delivery; use Sync when it is available to retry synchronization.
A fresh start—or a finished book

Starting again? Use Reset tracking. Putting this book aside? Use Stop tracking to remove it from your reading list. Both keep your saved reading position and finished history.\n\nReached the end? Take a moment to enjoy it, then use Finish to record completion. Finishing is your choice; reaching the final chapter alone does not mark the book finished. Your finished books appear at the bottom of Home, newest first.
Connect your account
Bring your Nostr identity along to sync your shelf and share your thoughts.
Bring your reading voice along

Ready to share a favourite passage or a review? Connect your Nostr identity with a compatible Android signer. Open Settings > Account & Sync, tap Connect account, and review the request in your signer.\n\nBrowsing, reading, and saving books work without an account, so you can connect whenever you feel ready.
Choose what you share

Connecting enables bookshelf sync and signed reviews. Saving books while connected can ask your signer to share your bookshelf publicly. Review those requests before approving them.\n\nReading lists and finished books have separate sharing choices in Settings > Reading progress & privacy. Check those choices before sharing your reading activity.
